% Guard: checks cases the fix must not break. The index and glossary
% files beside the document are current, as an Overleaf zip or an arXiv
% source ships them, and the document neither sorts them nor has a LaTeX
% error: \makeindex is commented out, and glossaries has no
% \makeglossaries. The page's index and glossary are read from them.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{makeidx}
%\makeindex
\usepackage{glossaries}
\newglossaryentry{fruit}{name={fruit},description={the seed-bearing part of a plant}}
\begin{document}
An apple\index{Apple} is a \gls{fruit}.
\printindex
\printglossary
\end{document}
